$comment: Local extension: upstream SAP abap-file-formats has no OAuth 2.0 client profile (OA2P) format. Field names map to OA2C_PROFILES (service provider type, no-authority-check flag) and OA2P_SCOPES (scope list); the ICF /oa2p/<name> wire document mirrors this shape.
title: OAuth 2.0 Client Profile Properties
description: OAuth 2.0 client profile (OA2P): a service provider type plus the scopes the profile requests

type.title: Service Provider Type
type.description: OAuth 2.0 service provider type (OA2C_PROFILES-TYPE / OA2C_TYPES, CHAR 20), e.g. DEFAULT or HANA_CLOUD_PLATFORM. The type must be configured in OA2C_TYPES.

noAuthCheck.title: No Authority Check
noAuthCheck.description: When true, the profile skips the S_OA2C_ADM authority check for its users (OA2C_PROFILES-NO_AUTH_CHECK). Defaults to false.

scopes.title: Scopes
scopes.description: OAuth 2.0 scopes requested for this profile (OA2P_SCOPES-SCOPE, one string per entry). Empty values are dropped by the SAP side.
